title: Tailor your resume to each job without starting over | SearchBreaker
description: Tailor a resume to a job using the experience you have actually verified. Learn the workflow, its controls and what you can review before applying.

blocks.headline: Tailor your resume to each job without starting over
blocks.lead: Start from the facts in your verified profile. SearchBreaker proposes edits for each job description, shows where every change comes from, and waits for your approval.

blocks.heading: Start from verified experience
blocks.lead: Tailoring works from facts you confirmed once, so every version stays true to your record.

items.title: Candidate facts
items.text: Every role, result and skill you confirm is stored once and reused. Tailoring can reword a fact but never add one.

items.title: Role-specific resume base
items.text: Keep a base resume per target role, so each tailored version starts close to the job.

blocks.heading: See what changes for this job
blocks.lead: Each proposed edit shows the job requirement it answers and the profile fact it comes from.

blocks.heading: Review every proposed edit
blocks.lead: Nothing reaches your resume until you accept it.

points.title: Check facts and tone
points.text: Each edit is checked against your profile facts and flagged if the wording overstates them.

points.title: Accept, edit or reject
points.text: Decide on each change separately. Rejected edits leave the original line in place.

points.title: Edit by hand at any time
points.text: Write your own version of any line. Your edits are never overwritten.

blocks.heading: Save the version you used
blocks.lead: Each application keeps the exact resume you sent, so follow-ups and interviews start from the right text.

items.title: Versioned resumes
items.text: Every tailored resume is saved as a numbered version with the job it was made for.

items.title: Linked to each application
items.text: Your application record shows which version you sent and when.

items.title: Restore any version
items.text: Start a new application from an earlier version instead of from scratch.

blocks.heading: What tailoring cannot do
blocks.lead: Tailoring improves how your real experience is presented. It does not change the experience itself.

items.title: It cannot add experience
items.text: If a requirement has no matching fact in your profile, tailoring marks it as a gap instead of filling it.

items.title: It does not guarantee interviews
items.text: A clearer resume helps readers find your evidence. Hiring decisions depend on much more.

items.title: It is not an ATS pass
items.text: Employers configure their systems differently. No tool can confirm how a resume will be parsed.

items.title: It depends on your profile
items.text: Outdated or missing facts produce weaker suggestions. Keep your profile current.
